annotation.interpretation_b: The experiment name should be concise and limited in length, perhaps to avoid excessively long identifiers (e.g., "h3-09-shortname"). The clause does not specify any length or format restrictions for the experiment name.
annotation.justification: The phrase "an experiment name" is not further defined. Without constraints on the experiment name, implementations could choose to use very long, complex names or short, simple names, leading to different identifiers for the same experiment.
annotation.missing_information: The clause lacks constraints on the format, length, or content of the "experiment name". This missing constraint allows for materially different implementations.
